Title: Scratch pad
BodyMd:
- Mobile first: most restaurant owners order on their phone, late in the evening
- Minimum order CHF 150 per delivery
- ERP import every evening at 18:30
- First scope to Jonas by end of next week

Title: RE: Online ordering for our customers (6 emails, 12-16 Oct)
BodyMd:
## Email 1 of 6

**From:** Jonas Meier
**To:** SELISE delivery team
**Date:** 12 Oct
**Time:** 16:40
**Subject:** Online ordering for our customers

Hello,

Thank you for the good conversation at the Gastro fair. As promised, here is a short summary of where we stand.

About 180 business customers order from us: restaurants, hotels, delis and small shops. Today they fill in our Excel order sheet and email it to our order desk, around 350 orders a week.

Our order desk retypes every sheet into our ERP. That is roughly 25 hours a week, and every week a few orders go wrong: wrong quantities, missed items, or sheets that arrive after the cut-off.

We would like our customers to order online instead. Can you help us with that?

Best regards,  
Jonas Meier  
Head of Operations, Alpine Fresh AG, Zurich

---

## Email 3 of 6

**From:** Jonas Meier
**To:** SELISE delivery team
**Date:** 13 Oct
**Time:** 14:05
**Subject:** RE: Online ordering for our customers

Hello,

Every customer has their own price list and only sees the items we deliver to them, about 2,400 articles in total: fruit and vegetables, dairy, meat and dry goods.

They should put an order together, send it, and repeat a previous order without typing everything again.

The orders must end up in our ERP. Today we import a CSV file every evening at 18:30.

And customers keep calling to ask where their delivery is. If they could see the status themselves, that would save my team a lot of phone time.

Jonas

Title: Call notes 16 Oct
BodyMd:
Call with Alpine Fresh · 16 Oct · 15:00–15:40  
Jonas Meier (Head of Operations), Petra Huber (order desk lead), me

- Most customers order almost the same every week. "Repeat last order" is the number one wish.
- Order desk = 4 people. They must be able to change an order before 18:00, e.g. when an item is out of stock.
- Delivery days by route, as on the order form (most customers get 2–3 deliveries a week).
- Customers want to see when the truck has left and when the order was delivered.
- Confirmation email after every order, to the customer and the order desk.
- Budget: around CHF 20'000 for the first version, confirmed by their CFO.
- Payment, Jonas: "All our customers are on a monthly invoice, and that stays."
- Sign-in: not clear yet if one login per customer or per person (chef, owner).
- Delivery time windows: some hotels want a slot before 7:00, for breakfast.
- Next: first scope to Jonas by end of next week.

Title: Whiteboard order flow (call 16 Oct)
BodyMd:
1. Customer logs in
2. Picks items or repeats the last order
3. Sends the order before 18:00
4. Confirmation e-mail
5. Order desk checks
6. Customer sees status: received → picked → on the way → delivered

Notes on the board:

- Mobile!!
- Min. order CHF 150
- Export to ERP 18:30

Title: Alpine Fresh order form and ordering rules
BodyMd:
## Order form

Alpine Fresh AG · Fresh food wholesale · Zurich  
Customer number · Customer name · Delivery address  
Delivery day · Ordered by · Phone  
Art. no. · Article · Unit · Quantity · Comment  
Please email the completed form to the order desk.

## Ordering rules

- Order cut-off: 18:00. Orders received after 18:00 are delivered on the next possible delivery day.
- Delivery days per route: Zurich City Mon, Wed, Fri · Winterthur Tue, Thu.
- Minimum order value: CHF 150.00 per delivery. Below that, a delivery fee of CHF 25.00 applies.
- Changes to a sent order are possible until 18:00 by phone to the order desk.
- Prices according to your personal price list, excluding VAT.
- Fresh goods can only be returned on the day of delivery.
